name: Proton Drive
author: loneycoffee
description: A cloud on the bar for Proton's official Drive CLI: browse My files, upload from the file chooser, download a file or folder with a click, and copy a public link to anything. Transfers run in the background and end in a notification. Right click uploads. Toggle the panel with: omarchy-shell shell toggle proton-drive

barWidget.description: Browse, upload, download and share Proton Drive files

schema.label: Right click uploads into (a Drive path)
